entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it'd be real bad if[n]that photo got out...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why are you bringing that up now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno. I mean, it's not[n]like we did anything bad.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We were just in the wrong[n]place at the wrong time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you think people wouldn't[n]understand even if we tried[n]to explain what went down...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think that would be tough.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I doubt anyone would even[n]listen to what we have to say.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If that photo got out, people[n]would treat every word out of our[n]mouths as nothing but a joke.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But if that truly came to pass,[n]it would be no joking matter...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we just gotta change[n]his heart after all, huh...
